svg.aria-label: Following pstack: every week, pstack's principles come into upstream/pstack at a pinned commit. Local versions in principles/ win. The build runs the checks and tests and makes the sage plugin. If pstack changed a principle that has a local version, the update waits for review; otherwise it merges.
